feed.title: Chapter 2: Supervised Learning — Civil Engineer's Guide to AI
feed.subtitle: Updates to Chapter 2 sub-lessons.

entry.title: 2.1 Supervised Learning Fundamentals
entry.summary: Master the fundamentals of supervised learning through a civil engineering lens. Understand features, labels, training workflows, regression vs classification, and real-world CE applications.

entry.title: 2.2 Linear Regression
entry.summary: Master linear regression from a civil engineering perspective. Learn the equation y = mx + b, least squares, gradient descent, cost functions, R-squared, and predict concrete strength from water-cement ratio.

entry.title: 2.3 Polynomial & Multiple Regression
entry.summary: Go beyond straight lines with polynomial regression and multiple linear regression. Learn to model nonlinear soil stress-strain curves, predict concrete strength from multiple mix factors, understand multicollinearity, and master adjusted R-squared.

entry.title: 2.4 Classification Basics
entry.summary: Learn the fundamentals of classification in machine learning through a civil engineering lens. Understand binary and multi-class classification, decision boundaries, k-nearest neighbours, confusion matrices, and real-world applications such as pass/fail testing, soil classification, and safety compliance.

entry.title: 2.5 Logistic Regression
entry.summary: Master logistic regression for civil engineering applications. Understand the sigmoid function, log-odds, probability thresholds, binary cross-entropy loss, multi-class softmax, and real-world CE applications such as failure prediction and dam safety classification.

entry.title: 2.6 Decision Trees & Random Forests
entry.summary: Master decision trees and random forests for civil engineering. Understand splitting criteria (Gini impurity, information gain), tree construction, pruning, overfitting, bagging, feature randomness, and ensemble voting with applications to material selection and structural risk assessment.

entry.title: 2.7 Support Vector Machines
entry.summary: Master Support Vector Machines for civil engineering applications. Understand maximum margin hyperplanes, support vectors, soft margin (C parameter), the kernel trick (linear, polynomial, RBF), SVR, and applications to earthquake damage classification and soil liquefaction prediction.

entry.title: 2.8 Model Evaluation Metrics
entry.summary: Master model evaluation metrics for civil engineering AI applications. Learn classification metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, confusion matrix), regression metrics (MAE, MSE, RMSE, R-squared), and cross-validation techniques with interactive demos.

entry.title: 2.9 Overfitting, Underfitting & Regularization
entry.summary: Understand overfitting, underfitting, the bias-variance tradeoff, and regularization techniques (L1, L2, Elastic Net, dropout, early stopping) with interactive demos and civil engineering analogies.

entry.title: 2.10 CE Case Study: Site Response Analysis
entry.summary: End-to-end supervised learning case study predicting seismic site response (ground motion amplification) from soil properties using ML. Capstone sub-chapter for Chapter 2.
